dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave trailing edge curvature fitting a smooth spline from the posterior insertion point to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with a wide pixel radius at the highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 45-degree slope relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.5:1 base width to vertical height ratio.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Convex curvature with a moderate radius forming a smooth transition from the blowhole area to the rostrum.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, thick rostrum with a blunt tip, extending from a distinct inflection point.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse angle approximately 150 degrees at the transition point between the melon and the rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible mottled light-to-dark pigmentation gradient along the lateral mid-body.
